column2: The basic auto-complete feature stores the information you enter into form fields and uses these entries to suggest relevant choices as you type into a field. Once you enter a character into a field, a drop-down box displays a list of only the most probable matches. Double-click or press Down Arrow in an empty field to display an even larger list of possible matches.

column2: The advanced auto-complete feature stores the information you enter into form fields and uses these entries to suggest relevant choices as you type into a field. If there are probable matches for a field, tabbing into that field will automatically display a list of them. If there is a very probable match, it will be entered in the field automatically. Pressing Tab while the pointer is over an entry in the list chooses the entry and moves to the next field.
column3: 高级自动完成功能可存储您在表单域中输入的信息，并在您在域中输入时使用这些内容提示相关的选择。如果存在可能与域匹配的项目，跳位至该域将自动显示包含这些项目的列表。如果存在精确匹配的项目，则将自动在域中输入。当指针位于列表的某个项目上时，按 Tab 键可选择该项目并移动到下一个域。

Check "Disable ConnectedPDF features" to disable all ConnectedPDF features.

Check "Disable 'Allow usage data to be used in ConnectedPDF features'" to forbid sharing usage data when using ConnectedPDF features. column2: The PDF/E standard defines provisions for the use and exchange of engineering documents in the PDF format. It allows for the inclusion of dynamic content, like 3D models as well as a range of annotations, and at the same time requires the presence of all content and resources in the PDF file to guarantee reliable viewing and printing.
column3: PDF/E标准定义了PDF格式的工程文档的使用和交换规范。除了一系列的标注外，它允许包含如3D模型等动态内容，同时要求PDF文件中包含所有内容和资源以保证可靠的查看和打印文件。

column2: PDF/E-1 requires that all page content and resources necessary for displaying or printing the document are included in the PDF file. A PDF/E file may be password protected and also supports the use of digital signatures.
column3: PDF/E-1要求用于显示和打印文档的所有页面内容和资源包含在PDF文件中。PDF/E格式的文档可以使用密码加密，同样也支持使用数字签名。

column2: The PDF/X standard defines provisions for reliable PDF exchange in the graphic arts industry. PDF/X files must contain all page content and resources for predictable viewing and output.
column3: PDF/X标准定义了图形艺术行业可靠的PDF交换的规范。PDF/X文件必须包含可预见查看和输出的所有页面内容与资源。

column2: PDF/X-1a requires that all page content and resources are embedded. Transparency and layers are prohibited, only CMYK and spot colors are allowed.
column3: PDF/X-1a 要求所有页面内容和资源是嵌入的。禁止透明效果和层，只允许CMYK和专色。

column2: PDF/X-3 requires that all page content and resources are embedded. Transparency and layers are prohibited. In addition to CMYK and spot colors, ICC based colors and Lab are allowed.
column3: PDF/X-3 要求所有页面内容和资源全部内嵌。透明和分层被禁止，除此外的CMYK，专色，基于ICC的色彩和Lab是允许的。

column2: PDF/X-4 requires that all page content and resources are embedded. Transparency and layers are allowed as well as CMYK, spot colors, ICC based colors and Lab.
column3: PDF/X-4要求所有页面内容和资源全部内嵌。除CMYK，专色，基于ICC的色彩和Lab外，也允许透明和分层。

column2: The PDF/A standard is available in two parts, where each part defines two or three conformance levels. It is recommended to choose the part and conformance level that matches the PDF document to be archived. Where digital signatures are required, it is important to ensure conformance with the PDF/A standard before signing the PDF.

column2: The PDF/E-1 standards enable the reliable exchange and use of documents like engineering drawings, CAD files and similar documents.

column2: The PDF/X standard defines provisions for reliable PDF exchange in the graphic arts industry. PDF/X files must contain all page content and resources for predictable viewing and output.
column3: PDF/X标准定义了图形艺术行业可靠的PDF交换的规范。PDF/X文件必须包含可预见查看和输出的所有页面内容与资源。

column2: The PDF/A standard defines provisions for long term archiving of electronic documents in the PDF format. All content in a PDF/A file must be contained in such a way that viewing or printing of the file can be achieved reliably over a long period of time.
column3: PDF/A标准适用于电子文档的长期存档。PDF/A文件所有用于查看以及打印的内容均以如此方式存储，所以可以可靠的存储较长时间。

column2: The PDF/E standard defines provisions for the use and exchange of engineering documents in the PDF format. It allows for the inclusion of dynamic content, like 3D models as well as a wide range of annotations, and at the same time requires the presence of all content and resources in the PDF file to guarantee reliable viewing and printing.
column3: PDF/E标准定义了PDF格式的工程文档的使用和交换规范。除了一系列的标注外，它允许包含如3D模型等动态内容，同时要求PDF文件中包含所有内容和资源以保证可靠的查看和打印文件。
